SELECT * FROM registration WHERE participant_id = #{participantId} AND event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registration (participant_id, event_id, schedule_id, status) VALUES (#{participantId}, #{eventId}, #{scheduleId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 0
SELECT r.event_id AS eventId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM registration r JOIN event e ON r.event_id = e.id WHERE e.sports_meeting_id = #{sportsMeetingId} AND r.status = 0 GROUP BY r.event_id

SELECT r.id, r.participant_id, r.event_id, r.schedule_id, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time, p.name AS participant_name, t.name AS team_name, e.name AS event_name, s.name AS schedule_name FROM registration r LEFT JOIN participant p ON r.participant_id = p.id LEFT JOIN team t ON p.team_id = t.id LEFT JOIN event e ON r.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON r.schedule_id = s.id WHERE e.sports_meeting_id = #{sportsMeetingId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.participant_id, r.event_id, r.schedule_id, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time, p.name AS participant_name, t.name AS team_name, e.name AS event_name, s.name AS schedule_name FROM registration r LEFT JOIN participant p ON r.participant_id = p.id LEFT JOIN team t ON p.team_id = t.id LEFT JOIN event e ON r.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON r.schedule_id = s.id WHERE r.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.participant_id, r.event_id, r.schedule_id, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time, p.name AS participant_name, t.name AS team_name, e.name AS event_name, s.name AS schedule_name FROM registration r LEFT JOIN participant p ON r.participant_id = p.id LEFT JOIN team t ON p.team_id = t.id LEFT JOIN event e ON r.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON r.schedule_id = s.id WHERE r.participant_id = #{participantId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE registration SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
